another property when stuck. Do not ignore an answer merely because it conflicts with a
preferred candidate.

Each ASK, rejected GUESS, or format error before the limit costs one turn. A correct GUESS costs
none. After 40 counted turns, make one final GUESS; ASK is then forbidden. Identity
validation uses only YES, NO, or UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN on GUESS ends the game without success.

turns.question: Did he survive the Trojan War?

evidence.excerpt: Britannica states that Achilles was killed by Paris and that Achilles and Paris both predeceased the fall of Troy.
The cited classical biography says that Achilles fell in battle at the Scaean gate before Troy was taken, while noting that his death itself is not narrated in the Iliad.

turns.question: Was he killed by an enemy combatant during the war, rather than dying by his own hand?

evidence.excerpt: According to legend, the Trojan prince Paris killed Achilles by shooting him in the heel with an arrow. Paris was avenging his brother, Hector, whom Achilles had slain. Though the death of Achilles is not described in the Iliad, his funeral is mentioned in Homer’s Odyssey.

During the war Paris seems to have had a secondary role: a good warrior but inferior to his brother Hector and to the Greek leaders whom he faced. Near the end of the war, Paris shot the arrow that, by Apollo’s help, caused the death of the hero Achilles.
